pages.pageTitle: Your partner for safe, reliable gas service
pages.intro: SiEnergy provides responsive natural gas service to growing communities across Texas, with safety, reliability, and customer care at the center of every connection.

richTextSections.heading: About SiEnergy
richTextSections.xhtml: Since 1998, SiEnergy has provided natural gas service to communities in Texas. The company works with customers, developers, and builders to support safe, efficient service and dependable community infrastructure.

richTextSections.heading: Customer Education
richTextSections.xhtml: Your monthly gas bill is calculated in part by comparing the current meter reading with the previous reading. Learn how residential meters record usage and where to find helpful account information.
Call before you dig. Know what is below. Contact 811 before beginning a digging project so underground utility lines can be located.

richTextSections.heading: Stay Safe While Using Natural Gas
richTextSections.xhtml: SiEnergy monitors its pipeline system to support the safe and efficient delivery of natural gas. Know how to recognize a possible gas leak and what to do from a safe location.

richTextSections.heading: Developers & Industrial Users
richTextSections.xhtml: From master-planned communities to large industrial projects, SiEnergy works with development teams to coordinate natural gas infrastructure from planning through implementation.

pages.metadataTitle: Understanding Your Natural Gas Bill | SiEnergy
pages.metadataDescription: Learn how to review a SiEnergy natural gas bill, understand usage and charges, and find payment or tariff information.
pages.intro: A clear bill starts with knowing where to find your account details, usage, charges, due date, and customer-service information.

richTextSections.heading: Bill Overview
richTextSections.xhtml: Review your statement for the service address, billing period, meter readings, gas usage, itemized charges, payments, account balance, and due date.

richTextSections.heading: Usage and Charges
richTextSections.xhtml: Natural gas usage is determined in part by comparing meter readings. Your statement provides the current billed usage and the charges applied to the account for that billing period.

richTextSections.heading: Questions or Payment Concerns
richTextSections.xhtml: Contact Customer Service at 888-468-7007, Option 3, if you have questions about your statement or need to discuss currently available payment arrangements.

richTextSections.heading: Rates and Tariffs
richTextSections.xhtml: Visit Regulatory & Important Links for current tariff documents, customer information, and links to applicable regulatory resources.

pages.metadataDescription: Learn natural gas safety basics, gas-odor emergency steps, 811 guidance, and information about SiEnergy field employees and equipment.
pages.intro: Know how natural gas behaves, how to recognize a possible leak, and what to do before digging or during an emergency.

richTextSections.heading: If You Smell Natural Gas
richTextSections.xhtml: Leave the home, building, or immediate area on foot. Do not operate electrical switches, phones, appliances, vehicles, or anything that could create a spark. From a safe location, call 911 and SiEnergy at 888-468-7007, Option 1.

richTextSections.heading: Natural Gas Basics
richTextSections.xhtml: Natural gas is naturally colorless and odorless. An odorant is added so a possible leak can be detected. Natural gas is primarily methane, is lighter than air, and can ignite when mixed with air and exposed to an ignition source.

richTextSections.heading: Call Before You Dig
richTextSections.xhtml: Contact 811 before a digging project so underground utility lines can be located. Wait for the required responses and respect the marked area before work begins.

richTextSections.heading: Field Safety
richTextSections.xhtml: Keep the area around your natural gas meter clear and accessible. Secure pets away from the meter when service personnel need access for reading, maintenance, testing, or replacement.

pages.metadataTitle: How to Read Your Natural Gas Meter | SiEnergy
pages.metadataDescription: Learn how a residential natural gas meter records usage and how to read common meter dials from left to right.
pages.intro: Your meter records natural gas usage. Understanding a meter reading can help you connect household usage with the information shown on your bill.

richTextSections.heading: How Meter Readings Work
richTextSections.xhtml: Your monthly bill is calculated in part by comparing the current meter reading with the previous reading. The difference represents the natural gas recorded during the billing period.

richTextSections.heading: Read the Dials
richTextSections.xhtml:
1. Read the dials from left to right.
  2. When a pointer is between two numbers, record the lower number.
  3. When a pointer is between zero and nine, record nine.
  4. Record the reading and compare it with the meter information on your statement.

richTextSections.heading: Keep the Meter Accessible
richTextSections.xhtml: Keep landscaping, stored materials, and other obstructions away from the meter so it remains visible and accessible to authorized service personnel.

images.alt: Residential natural gas meter mounted outside a Texas home

pages.metadataTitle: Tips to Lower Natural Gas Usage | SiEnergy
pages.metadataDescription: Explore practical ways to manage household natural gas use through thermostat settings, maintenance, insulation, and everyday habits.
pages.intro: Small changes in home operation and maintenance can help reduce unnecessary natural gas use while supporting everyday comfort.

richTextSections.heading: Heating and Home Comfort
richTextSections.xhtml:
• Use a programmable or smart thermostat to match heating with your schedule.
  • Schedule regular maintenance for heating equipment.
  • Seal air leaks and improve insulation where appropriate.
  • Close fireplace dampers when the fireplace is not in use.

richTextSections.heading: Water Heating and Appliances
richTextSections.xhtml:
• Use appliance settings that match the task and run full loads when practical.
  • Follow manufacturer guidance for water-heater temperature and maintenance.
  • Compare energy-efficient equipment when replacing an appliance.

richTextSections.heading: Build Better Habits
richTextSections.xhtml: Review seasonal usage in your account, make one change at a time, and compare future bills while accounting for weather and household activity.

pages.metadataTitle: Report a Natural Gas Emergency | SiEnergy
pages.metadataDescription: If you suspect a natural gas leak, leave the area immediately and call 911 and SiEnergy's 24-hour emergency line from a safe location.
pages.intro: If you smell natural gas or suspect a leak, act immediately. Your safety comes first.

richTextSections.heading: Leave Immediately
richTextSections.xhtml: Evacuate everyone from the home, building, or immediate area. Leave on foot and move to a safe location.

richTextSections.heading: Avoid Ignition Sources
richTextSections.xhtml: Do not operate electrical switches, phones, appliances, flashlights, vehicles, or heavy equipment in the affected area. Do not smoke, use a lighter, or create any source of ignition.

richTextSections.heading: Call From a Safe Location
richTextSections.xhtml: Call 911 and SiEnergy's 24-hour emergency line at 888-468-7007, Option 1. Follow instructions from emergency responders and SiEnergy personnel.
